zoe_sales: VectorAir POC is stuck during the demo. /generate returns 403 invalid_project_claim. They say the key in their k8s env is "active". Can eng triage fast?

-devx_ian: Paste the exact curl and the raw response + request_id from their client logs.

zoe_sales: They sent this: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_VCTR' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Org: vectorair' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Project: vector-staging' \
  -d '{"model":"rw/gpt-9b","input":"hello"}'```
Raw response: `{"error":"invalid_project_claim","status":403,"hint":"token project claim=vector-core != header vector-staging","request_id":"r-VCTR-2026-77"}`

harish_eng: That hint is explicit  token claims project=vector-core but header says vector-staging. Usually happens when the app picks up an older key from env or Vault/CI injected a different secret.

zoe_sales: They use Vault + k8s secrets; engineer on call says they updated the secret but pods might still have old env.

devx_ian: Two quick paths: 1) Rotate/create a new project-scoped key in Console -> Projects -> vector-staging -> Keys -> Create and update secrets, then restart pods. 2) Temporary workaround: remove X-Redwood-Project header so server uses token claim (only OK for single-project flows). Recommend rotation + restart for POC.

harish_eng: Also confirm whether the token is an API key (sk_*) or a service JWT. If it's a JWT, the CI may be minting tokens with the wrong "project" claim. Have them paste header+payload (redact signature) or give request_id so we can decode server-side.

ops_sam: We tightened project binding policy recently; old global keys will 403 now if header mismatches. If they can't rotate right now we can add a short routing exception for tenant_id but that needs change-control (~2h).

zoe_sales: Customer also saw a flurry of 429s earlier when their retry loop kicked in. If we fix auth and they replay everything we'll hit quotas. Any temporary quota we can provide for the demo?

ops_sam: For quick demos we can bump project quotas: burst=80, steady=7rps for 24h. I can apply and audit in the ticket. Please ask them to pause aggressive retries and use exponential backoff.

devx_ian: Dev snippet to share with their engineer: make sure token claims and headers align. Node example:```js
fetch(url, { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer sk_demo_VCTR', 'X-Redwood-Org': 'vectorair', 'X-Redwood-Project': 'vector-core' } })```

harish_eng: If they rotated but still 403, have them paste the JWT payload (no signature) or send request_id r-VCTR-2026-77 and we'll decode server-side. Don't paste private material.

zoe_sales: They're finishing a security questionnaire and asked about rotation cadence and RBAC. Can ops drop a short blurb I can send?

ops_sam: SQ blurb: "We support project-scoped API keys and service tokens; keys may be rotated via Console or API. RBAC is enforced via org/project scoping. For Private deployments we offer KMS/HSM integrations and audit logs. Recommended rotation cadence depends on customer policy (30-90 days common). SOC2 artifact links available on request."

support-bot: support-bot: ticket #SUP-2026-699 created for request_id=r-VCTR-2026-77, assigned to eng-triage.

zoe_sales: I'm telling them to rotate the key, restart pods, and hold off on replays. I'll paste the new curl when they swap.

harish_eng: Also check their CI pipeline for a cached secret or an older image with baked-in env. We've seen Vault token TTLs cause apps to keep old values until restart.

devx_ian: If they want reliable throughput during the POC, suggest a 30-day Dedicated trial in the quote  avoids quota juggling. Sales, we can prep terms.

zoe_sales: Thanks all  I'll update the ticket and follow up here when they confirm the rotation. :thumbsup:
